title: Rights to data and system software.
bodyText: The legislature is the sole and exclusive owner of all rights, titles, and interests in and to legislatively-generated databases, including but not limited to all computer software and certain data.
bodyHtml: [§21D-4]  Rights to data and system software.  The legislature is the sole and exclusive owner of all rights, titles, and interests in and to legislatively-generated databases, including but not limited to all computer software and certain data. [L 1990, c 348, pt of §1]
